tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: 为 HTTP 或 HTTPS 目标地址创建一条短链。需要已注册账号。重试必须复用相同的 idempotency_key。 Create one HTTP or HTTPS short link (URL shortener / 短网址). A registered account is required. Retry with the same idempotency_key.

tools.name: shorten_urls
tools.description: 按 client_ref 对应，一次创建多条短链，可部分成功。需已注册账号。 Create several short links in one call, matched by client_ref. Partial success is allowed. A registered account is required.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: 按 id 查询当前授权账号拥有的链接。需要已注册账号。公开状态查询用 resolve_short_url。 Fetch one owned link by id. A registered account is required. For a public status check, use resolve_short_url.

tools.name: resolve_short_url
tools.description: 查询本站短码或本站短链的已保存状态；仅 active 时返回目标地址。无需账号。不查询其他短链服务；结果不是安全结论。 Look up a 短.在线 code or short URL. Returns saved state, and the destination only when active. No account required. Does not look up other shorteners. Not a security verdict.

tools.name: create_qr
tools.description: 为已有短链返回二维码。新目标须先 shorten_url 再调用本工具。需已注册的所有者。不新建短链，不抓取目标地址。编码带 ?s=qr 的 ASCII 短链，与 GET /v1/links/{id}/qr 相同。image_url 不是 API 密钥、OAuth 令牌或会话。 QR for an existing short link you own. For a new destination, call shorten_url first, then create_qr. Does not create a link or fetch the destination. Encodes t

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: 列出当前账号拥有的短链。cursor 与 limit 同 GET /v1/links。需要 links:read。 List links this account owns. cursor and limit match GET /v1/links. Requires links:read.

tools.name: get_link_analytics
tools.description: 汇总点击统计。period 为 7d、30d 或 90d，截至昨天。clicks 是窗口内全部已存储点击，含机器人，不是人数。qr_clicks 只计人类且带二维码标记的点击，不含机器人。少于 5 次并入 other。 Aggregate click statistics. period is 7d, 30d, or 90d, ending yesterday. clicks counts every stored click row in the window, including bots, and is not a count of people. qr_clicks counts hu

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: 修改自有短链的标题或目标地址。需要 links:update。未验证邮箱或注册未满 7 天只能改标题。不会重新启用短链。 Change the title or destination of a link you own. Requires links:update. Unverified email or an account under 7 days old can change the title only. Does not re-enable a link.

tools.name: disable_link
tools.description: 停用你拥有的短链，停用后短链和二维码将停止跳转。需要 links:disable 与已验证邮箱。幂等。 Disable a link you own: its short link and QR code stop redirecting. Requires links:disable and a verified email. Idempotent.

tools.name: begin_registration
tools.description: 客户端无法启动 OAuth 时的后备入口。返回浏览器注册链接。不创建账号，不接收密码，也不代用户同意条款。 Fallback when the client cannot start OAuth. Returns a browser registration link. Does not create an account, accept a password, or accept terms.

tools.name: prepare_campaign_pack
tools.description: 从你提供的表格行生成短链接和二维码文件：分配 item_id、创建短链接与二维码；与你提供的表格行一一对应，每个二维码编码的都是对应的返回短链接；并返回可下载文件。部分行可成功。需要已注册账号。 Prepare short links and QR files from tabular rows you provide: assign item_id, create short links and QR codes; match each item to the row you provided so that each QR encodes the returned short link;

tools.name: get_campaign_pack
tools.description: 按 campaign_id 返回活动状态、逐行结果与可下载文件。需要已注册账号。 Fetch campaign state, per-item results, and downloadable files by campaign_id. Registered account required.

tools.name: retry_campaign_pack
tools.description: 在同一 campaign_id 内重试失败或你已更正的行，不重复已成功的项。需要已注册账号。 Retry failed items or items you have already corrected within the same campaign_id, without duplicating items that already succeeded. Registered account required.

tools.name: save_campaign_setup
tools.description: 保存可复用的列映射与输出格式；不复制链接身份。需要已注册账号。 Save reusable column mappings and output format; does not copy link identities. Registered account required.

tools.name: apply_campaign_setup
tools.description: 将 setup 应用于新活动或显式恢复。新活动产生新 campaign/item 身份。需要已注册账号。 Apply a setup to a new campaign or explicit recovery. New campaigns get new identities. Registered account required.
